package lesson

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

type teacherContextI18nRepository struct {
	items []domain.LessonI18n
}

func (*teacherContextI18nRepository) Upsert(context.Context, domain.LessonI18n) error { return nil }
func (repository *teacherContextI18nRepository) ListByLesson(context.Context, string) ([]domain.LessonI18n, error) {
	return repository.items, nil
}

func TestGetTeacherContextSelectsExactTranslationAndRevision(t *testing.T) {
	revision := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 12, 0, 0, 123000, time.UTC)
	lessons := &materialsLessonRepository{lessons: map[string]domain.Lesson{
		materialsRootLessonID: {
			ID: materialsRootLessonID, CourseID: "course-1", SectionID: "section-1",
			Title: "Base", Description: "Base body", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive, UpdatedAt: revision,
		},
	}}
	translations := &teacherContextI18nRepository{items: []domain.LessonI18n{{
		LessonID: materialsRootLessonID, Language: "ru", Title: "Циклы",
		Excerpt: "Кратко", Description: "Канонический текст урока",
	}}}

	result, err := (GetTeacherContext{Lessons: lessons, LessonI18n: translations}).Handle(
		context.Background(), materialsRootLessonID, "RU",
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get teacher context: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Language != "ru" || result.Title != "Циклы" || result.Revision != revision {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected context: %#v", result)
	}
}

func TestGetTeacherContextRejectsInactiveLesson(t *testing.T) {
	lessons := &materialsLessonRepository{lessons: map[string]domain.Lesson{
		materialsRootLessonID: {ID: materialsRootLessonID, Status: domain.LessonStatusNoActive, UpdatedAt: time.Now()},
	}}
	_, err := (GetTeacherContext{Lessons: lessons}).Handle(context.Background(), materialsRootLessonID, "ru")
	if err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("expected not found, got %v", err)
	}
}
